_about: Regression oracle for retrieval_quality_eval.py. Each metric and semantic result was reviewed against the retrieval contract and the named case, not accepted merely because a run produced it. A case is matched only by the packet kind that can answer it, and per-case positions and packet counts are diagnostics, so incidental packet shape is not pinned here. The deterministic embedder folds common English suffixes so a verb and its gerund share one token; ranking is not decided by hash noise.
_reviewed_against: current claims are served before their raw evidence
history and as_of label the old claim historical; the current head stays current
same-source revision 2 replaces revision 1 in current mode
a cross-scope query returns no_match with no claim or vector item
a tool-only proposal waits for evidence with no_derivation_root and stays proposed
a human-backed candidate is evaluated and becomes an active claim
a related production-port claim does not take the first slot for a staging-port question
the paraphrase of the staging-port question also keeps the production-port claim behind the gold claim
